status_effects.explanation: His confessed, deliberate attempt to frighten Albertine into abandoning her plan positions him locally as manipulative rather than sympathetic.
Cited, in passing, as the origin of an arbitrary and tyrannical impulse toward loved ones, a mild discredit by association.

appraisal_events.evidence: « J'avais sans doute hérité de mon père ce brusque désir arbitraire de menacer les êtres que j'aimais le plus... je disais négligemment, pour la faire trembler, que je comptais sortir ce jour-là. »
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator admits to a deliberate, staged act of intimidating Albertine to frighten her into compliance, a self-critical confession that casts his in-scene conduct as manipulative rather than admirable.

appraisal_events.evidence: « J'avais sans doute hérité de mon père ce brusque désir arbitraire de menacer les êtres que j'aimais le plus dans les espérances dont ils se bercâient avec une sécurité que je voulais leur montrer trompeuse. »
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator names his father as the genealogical source of his own arbitrary, fear-inducing impulse toward loved ones, mildly implicating the father in the same unflattering trait by association.
